item.text: === BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-Inline-Emphasis.md === # FEATURE: Inline Emphasis | Field | Value | |-------------|-------| | Version | 20260815 V1 | | Description | Parse CommonMark emphasis and strong emphasis using the delimiter-run algorithm. | | Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, FEATURE-Inline-Basics.md | | Provides | emphasis parsing, strong-emphasis parsing | | Consumes | executable commonmark, block structure, inline basics | ## Questions - None. ## Purpose Implement emphasis and strong emphasis after block parsing and basic inline tokenization. ## Behavior - Apply the CommonMark delimiter-run algorithm for `*`, `_`, `**`, and `__`. - Enforce intraword, Unicode whitespace, Unicode punctuation, and multiple-of-three rules. - Support nested emphasis, strong emphasis, unmatched delimiters, and precedence with code spans, links, images, and HTML. - Render emphasis as `` and strong emphasis as ``. ## Programmatic Acceptance === AC emphasis-conformance === Intent: The implementation passes every supplied conformance example owned by emphasis and strong emphasis. Suite: scoped import subprocess import sys result = subprocess.run( [ sys.executable, "sources/spec_tests.py", "--program", "./commonmark", "--spec", "sources/spec.txt", "--pattern", r"^Emphasis and strong emphasis$", ], capture_output=True, text=True, ) print(result.stdout) print(result.stderr, file=sys.stderr) assert result.returncode == 0 === END AC emphasis-conformance === ## User Acceptance - None. ## Guardrails - Do not use a public Markdown implementation. - Preserve block-before-inline parsing. - Do not modify supplied conformance assets. === END ARTIFACT === === BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-Inline-Links-Images.md === # FEATURE: Inline Links and Images | Field | Value | |-------------|-------| | Version | 20260815 V1 | | Description | Parse CommonMark inline links, reference links, and images with destinations, titles, and label resolution. | | Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, FEATURE-Block-Leafs.md, FEATURE-Inline-Basics.md | | Provides | inline links, reference links, images | | Consumes | executable commonmark, link reference definitions, inline basics | ## Questions - None. ## Purpose Implement inline and reference links and images using the document-wide link reference map produced during block parsing. ## Behavior - Parse inline links and images with empty or nonempty destinations and optional titles. - Parse full-reference, collapsed-reference, and shortcut links and images. - Normalize labels using case folding and whitespace normalization. - Support escaped and balanced brackets, escaped destinations and titles, entity references, nested image descriptions, and first-definition precedence. - Prevent links from containing links while preserving permitted nested image behavior. - Render links with `` and images with `` using plain-text image alt content. ## Programmatic Acceptance === AC links-images-conformance === Intent: The implementation passes every supplied conformance example owned by links and images. Suite: scoped import subprocess import sys result = subprocess.run( [ sys.executable, "sources/spec_tests.py", "--program", "./commonmark", "--spec", "sources/spec.txt", "--pattern", r"^(Links|Images)$", ], capture_output=True, text=True, ) print(result.stdout) print(result.stderr, file=sys.stderr) assert result.returncode == 0 === END AC links-images-conformance === ## User Acceptance - None. ## Guardrails - Do not use a public Markdown implementation. - Preserve document-wide reference-definition precedence. - Do not modify supplied conformance assets. === END ARTIFACT === === BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-Inline-HTML-Autolinks.md === # FEATURE: Inline HTML and Autolinks | Field | Value | |-------------|-------| | Version | 20260815 V1 | | Description | Parse CommonMark URI autolinks, email autolinks, and raw HTML constructs. | | Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, FEATURE-Block-Leafs.md, FEATURE-Inline-Basics.md | | Provides | URI autolinks, email autolinks, raw HTML | | Consumes | executable commonmark, block structure, inline basics | ## Questions - None. ## Purpose Implement inline autolinks and raw HTML while preserving their precedence over ordinary text and emphasis. ## Behavior - Parse absolute URI autolinks and valid email autolinks. - Render URI autolinks as links to their URI and email autolinks with `mailto:` destinations. - Recognize valid open and closing tags, comments, processing instructions, declarations, and CDATA sections. - Preserve valid raw HTML without Markdown interpretation inside the raw construct. - Reject malformed tags and autolinks as literal escaped text. - Respect precedence with code spans, links, images, and emphasis. ## Programmatic Acceptance === AC html-autolinks-conformance === Intent: The implementation passes every supplied conformance example owned by autolinks and raw HTML. Suite: scoped import subprocess import sys result = subprocess.run( [ sys.executable, "sources/spec_tests.py", "--program", "./commonmark", "--spec", "sources/spec.txt", "--pattern", r"^(Autolinks|Raw HTML)$", ], capture_output=True, text=True, ) print(result.stdout) print(result.stderr, file=sys.stderr) assert result.returncode == 0 === END AC html-autolinks-conformance === ## User Acceptance - None. ## Guardrails - Do not use a public Markdown implementation. - Preserve raw HTML exactly where the specification requires it. - Do not modify supplied conformance assets. === END ARTIFACT === === BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-Conformance-Verification.md === # FEATURE: Conformance Verification | Field | Value | |-------------|-------| | Version | 20260815 V1 | | Description | Verify the completed parser against the complete supplied CommonMark 0.31.2 conformance suite. | | Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, FEATURE-Block-Leafs.md, FEATURE-Block-Quotes.md, FEATURE-Block-Lists.md, FEATURE-Inline-Basics.md, FEATURE-Inline-Emphasis.md, FEATURE-Inline-Links-Images.md, FEATURE-Inline-HTML-Autolinks.md | | Provides | complete CommonMark conformance verification | | Consumes | executable commonmark, all parser capabilities | ## Questions - None. ## Purpose Provide the terminal verification step for the completed command-line parser. ## Behavior - Stage `spec.txt`, `spec_tests.py`, `cmark.py`, `normalize.py`, and `full_test.sh` unchanged. - Run `sh sources/full_test.sh` from the completed application root. - Treat the supplied scoring entry point's exit status as the verification result. - Keep the suite unfiltered and terminal. ## Programmatic Acceptance === AC complete-conformance === Intent: The completed parser passes the complete unfiltered supplied CommonMark conformance suite. Suite: full import subprocess result = subprocess.run( ["sh", "sources/full_test.sh"], capture_output=True, text=True, ) print(result.stdout) print(result.stderr, file=sys.stderr) assert result.returncode == 0 === END AC complete-conformance === ## User Acceptance - None. ## Guardrails - This is the only full-suite acceptance check. - Do not filter, skip, reinterpret, or modify the supplied scoring assets. - Do not modify the supplied scoring entry point. === END ARTIFACT ===
